context: Every new cloud session prints a false "CLAUDE_CODE_EXECPATH is not set" line. The environment's snapshot was built Nov 3 15:34 CST at da8d8073, before #1116. Main is correct: the lane proved it in a fresh run at 12:01 CST. Only you can rebuild the environment; a session cannot edit its own environment.

lastAnswer.note: Done 21:31 CST Nov 5. New cloud sessions start from the rebuilt snapshot.

steps: In any cloud session, open the environment menu in the session's title bar.
Save with no change; that rebuilds the snapshot.
Mark done. It is done when a new session starts without the EXECPATH line.
title: Rebuild the cloud environment snapshot
